$comment: Named stress scenarios for this dataset's world. Each is a stated view, not a forecast. Severity multipliers are applied by the impact engine (mild 0.5, base 1, severe 2).

scenarios.name: Strait of Hormuz reopens
scenarios.description: Ceasefire holds, tanker traffic normalises, energy risk premium unwinds. Energy and shipping give back gains; risk assets and Asian currencies recover; gold and duration lose their safe-haven bid.
scenarios.probabilityNote: Unresolved as of the dataset's today; the blockade was reimposed on 5 Aug 2026. Treat as a plausible, not central, case.

scenarios.name: Middle East escalation
scenarios.description: Renewed attacks on shipping, sustained closure. Energy and shipping rally further, risk assets fall, dollar and gold bid, rates rise on inflation.
scenarios.probabilityNote: The 5 Aug 2026 blockade makes this the path of least surprise; magnitude is the uncertainty.

scenarios.name: Fed hikes 25bp
scenarios.description: Market pricing shifts from holds to a hike. Duration sells off, growth valuations compress, dollar strengthens.
scenarios.probabilityNote: Two holds with dissents (17 Jun, 29 Jul 2026); the 10-year is already at 4.66%.

scenarios.name: Technology drawdown repeats
scenarios.description: A second AI-capex scare of the 5 June 2026 kind: megacap technology falls hard, concentrated single names fall harder, tech-backed collateral shrinks.
scenarios.probabilityNote: Narrow, technology-led leadership at the half-year close makes a repeat plausible.

scenarios.name: Hong Kong property leg down
scenarios.description: Hong Kong residential and commercial prices fall a further leg; developers, their perpetuals and accumulators referencing them fall together.
scenarios.probabilityNote: The accumulator is already settling against the client; this is the concentration risk in one move.
